en: Black‑and‑white view from a dirt road descending into a valley, framed by trees and village houses. In the mid‑ground a stone bridge and fenced path cross a stream. Beyond, on a rise, stands a large Renaissance‑style castle complex with multiple gabled roofs and corner towers. To the left of the castle rises a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped spire. Rolling hills and scattered buildings lie in the background, giving a Central European small‑town impression. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
